description: DIBAVOD (digital base of water management data, Czechia) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by T. G. Masaryk Water Research Institute (VÚV TGM), GIS department. DIBAVOD is a thematic water-management geographic database built from ZABAGED layers. The page refers to flood-area maps at 1:10,000, watercourse and basin characteristics, flood-protection areas and water-source protection zones, offered as ESRI shapefiles in ZIP archives. Coverage: Czechia. Formats and interfaces named: SHP. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated on the page; the page gives a contact for questions on data use. Caveats: the page states that DIBAVOD "is not currently updated", so the layers may lag the real network; licence terms are not on the page. It can support flood-defence, watercourse and drinking-water protection-zone studies in Czechia. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
